headline: Ludhiana Fire Detections Decrease as Air Quality Forecast Remains Elevated
briefing: On 2024-11-10, Ludhiana recorded 3 fire detections with a total fire radiative power of 8.9 MW, ranking number 10 in Punjab [K057]. Detections represent a lower bound due to missed fires, cloud cover, and overpass timing [K057]. Wind blew from the ESE at 5.2 km/h, with upwind fire pressure led by Sangrur at 60.9% and Outside Punjab at 13.2%. Today's PM2.5 level was 142.0 ug/m3. The next-day PM2.5 forecast for Ludhiana projects a p50 of 117.7 ug/m3, with an 80% uncertainty band ranging from a p10 of 75.5 ug/m3 to a p90 of 146.5 ug/m3. Satellite detections are a lower bound and do not capture all burning activity [K057]. Model evaluation shows an MAE of 11.0 with 87.7% coverage across test seasons.
